validate_task_spec.task_title: Task 4: Route replies that contain a ZIP
validate_task_spec.goal: A reply that carries a ZIP code updates the lead's ZIP field.
acceptance_criteria: When the lead states a ZIP code, the lead's ZIP field holds it after the turn.
validate_task_spec.context: The model already extracts structured fields into an ExtractedFields record each turn.
boundary_rules: Code checks structured data only. It never inspects reply or user words: no regex, phrase or keyword matching over them. Exception: STOP and HELP are matched in code, as carrier rules require.
The LLM writes every reply. The only code-written text is verbatim legal text.

validate_completion.summary: ZipRouter now finds a five-digit ZIP in the reply with a regex and stores it.
